name: 随机数生成器（范围任意）

map.随机数生成器（范围任意）是做什么的？: What does Random Number Generator do?
map.如何使用随机数生成器（范围任意）？: How do I use Random Number Generator?
map.随机数生成器（范围任意）适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Random Number Generator best for?
map.范围任意: Generate random integers within any minimum and maximum range and quantity you set, entirely in the browser.
map.随机数生成：每项由 randInt(min,max) = floor(rando: Random number generation: each item is produced independently by randInt(min, max) = floor(random × (max − min + 1)) + min, with random drawn from a uniform [0, 1) distribution; for N independent uniform random numbers the theoretical mean is (min + max) / 2 and the theoretical range is max − min; the sample mean converges toward the theoretical mean as the sample size grows, which can be used to sanity-check the uniformity of draws and sampling.
map.得 [min,max] 均匀随机整数/浮点。: Produces a uniformly random integer or float in [min, max].
map.抽奖或分班从 [1,N] 随机取编号，避免人为挑选造成不公。: For a draw or class assignment, pick numbers at random from [1, N] to avoid the unfairness of manual selection.
map.随机不可复现，需种子另用。: Random values cannot be reproduced; a seed would be needed separately.
map.接口，日常抽签足够用；需要密码学强度或可审计的抽签应采用专门的随机源。: API provided by the browser, which is enough for everyday draws; cryptographic-strength or auditable draws should use a dedicated random source.
map.随机数生成器（范围任意）。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: Random Number Generator. A daily-life tool that is practical and convenient.
